text: 百利天恒公告，公司已于2026年8月6日向香港联交所递交境外上市外资股（H股）发行并上市的申请，并于同日在香港联交所网站刊登申请资料。该申请资料为草拟版本，所载资料可能会适时作出更新和变动。本次发行申请尚需取得中国证监会、香港证监会及香港联交所等监管机构的批准、核准或备案，事项仍存在不确定性。
text_en: SystImmune announced that the company submitted an application to the Hong Kong Stock Exchange on August 6, 2026 for the issuance and listing of overseas-listed foreign shares (H-shares), and posted the application materials on the HKEX website the same day. The application materials are draft versions and may be updated and revised as appropriate. The issuance is still subject to approvals, authorizations or filings from regulatory authorities including the CSRC, the SFC and the HKEX, and remains uncertain.
